372.name: Landscape and Lawn Care
372.summary: Full-service lawn and landscape care for Delta and Montrose — mowing, fertilizing, spraying, cleanup, and aeration, all tuned to how yards actually grow on the Western Slope.

364.name: Landscaping
364.summary: Landscape construction that blends hardscape and planting — walls, patios, water features, and lawns — built to quality and to what lasts in our soil and climate.

365.name: Sprinkler Systems
365.summary: Design, install, repair, and seasonal service for every system out here — domestic, irrigation, well, and dual — built to conserve our water and keep things green.

1505.name: Lighting
1505.summary: Landscape, exterior, and holiday lighting — designed and installed to highlight your property and stand up to Colorado seasons, from subtle path lights to full Christmas displays.

373.name: Snow Removal
373.summary: Plowing, shoveling, and ice control for homes, lots, and sidewalks — we stay on top of the storm and come back for windblown drift and ice to keep your property safe.

397.name: Mowing
397.summary: Regular, special, and vacant-lot mowing across Delta and Montrose — cut at the right height for our climate so your turf stays thick enough to shade out weeds and hold moisture.

377.name: Weekly Lawn Mowing
377.summary: Weekly mowing tailored to your grass and cut at its ideal height — the single biggest thing you can do for turf that's thick, drought-tolerant, and able to crowd out weeds.

395.name: Lawn Special Mowing
395.summary: One-off and vacant-lot mowing — knock the weeds down before the town sends a notice, or get the yard looking perfect for a wedding or graduation.

367.name: Fertilizing
367.summary: Licensed, slow-release feeding built for our high-limestone soil, where the wrong pH locks nutrients away — and we watch for insects, disease, and weeds at every visit.

417.name: Trees and Shrubs (Fertilizing)
417.summary: Slow-release spring feeding for trees and shrubs — replacing the nutrients our compacted, high-pH urban soils can't supply, for a stronger start to the season.

366.name: Spraying
366.summary: Colorado-licensed weed, insect, and disease control for lawns, beds, and trees — certified technicians who know our native weeds and Western Slope pests, from pre-emergent to dormant oil.

379.name: Licensed Weed Control
379.summary: Colorado-licensed weed control for lawns and beds by certified applicators who know our native and noxious weeds — realistic, season-long management, not a one-time miracle.

398.name: Licensed Insect Control
398.summary: Colorado-licensed insect control for lawns, trees, and shrubs — targeting the pests common to our area with properly timed, certified applications.

410.name: Pre-emergent
410.summary: A pre-emergent herbicide that stops weed seeds before they sprout — most effective applied early with our spring moisture; sign up by March 1 to lock in the season.

399.name: Aspen Twig Gall
399.summary: Spring treatment for the wasp behind those unsightly galls on aspen twigs — a systemic application that reliably cuts the galls back even though it won't wipe them out entirely.

407.name: Cooley Spruce Gall Treatment
407.summary: A once-a-year treatment for Cooley spruce gall on Colorado blue spruce, timed to knock the gall back before it disfigures new growth.

406.name: Deciduous Bore Treatment
406.summary: Protection against wood-boring insects that target stressed trees — paired with our advice on watering and health, since a well-hydrated tree is a borer's worst enemy.

401.name: Dormant Oil
401.summary: An early-spring oil spray that smothers overwintering insect eggs before they hatch — applied before your trees and shrubs leaf out, when it does the most good.

408.name: Grub Prevention
408.summary: Treatment for the white grubs that chew turf roots into fall — worst on drought-stressed lawns, so we time prevention before the damage ever shows.

402.name: Pine Needle Scale
402.summary: Treatment for pine needle scale on pinyon pines — the late-summer feeder that slowly weakens a tree and leaves it open to bigger problems.

400.name: Pinyon Pine Ips Beetle
400.summary: Cover-spray protection against the ips beetle that can kill a pinyon fast — applied three times a season (Memorial Day, July 1, September 1) to keep it out of the bark.

405.name: Trunk Bore Prevention
405.summary: Preventative trunk treatment that protects vulnerable trees from boring insects before they get established — cheap insurance against losing a mature tree.

376.name: Yard Cleanup
376.summary: Full cleanup — raking, bed clearing, shrub trimming, and haul-off — so your yard heads into and out of each Western Slope season clean instead of buried.

413.name: Fall Cleanup
413.summary: Fall cleanup decides how April looks — clearing leaves before they mat and smother turf, hauling off windfall fruit that draws bears, and timing the last mow to beat snow mold.

411.name: Spring Cleanup
411.summary: A spring reset — clearing winter debris, cutting back what we left standing over winter, and getting beds and turf ready before the growing season starts.

412.name: Summer Pruning
412.summary: Warm-season pruning to shape and thin trees and shrubs during active growth — cleaning up structure and keeping sightlines and airflow open.

389.name: Aeration
389.summary: Core aeration to break up the compacted soils common here, letting air and water reach the roots so your lawn roots deeper and shrugs off our dry spells.

404.name: Dethatching
404.summary: Power raking to pull the built-up thatch that seals off water and air — important on our heavy soils, where a thick mat starves the roots.

388.name: Pruning
388.summary: Skilled pruning that keeps the natural shape of your trees and shrubs — healthier plants, no ugly stubs, and cuts timed around our hard freezes.

1650.name: Winter Pruning
1650.summary: Dormant-season pruning for cleaner cuts and stronger spring growth — the right time to shape structure, remove hazards, and cut the risk of snow and storm breakage.

416.name: Weed Pulling in Shrubs
416.summary: Hand-pulling weeds out of your shrub and landscape beds — keeping mulch and plantings clean without spraying up against what you want to keep.

409.name: Deer Prevention Wire
409.summary: Wire fencing wrapped around vulnerable trees and shrubs for winter, when deer turn to your buds and bark — up in fall, down and stored come spring.

390.name: Misc Services
390.summary: The odd jobs that don't fit a category — if it's outdoors on your Delta or Montrose property, ask and we'll tell you straight whether we can help.

374.name: New Landscapes
374.summary: Full new landscapes — nearly 200 built across Delta County in the last decade — from sod and water features to retaining walls, planned around what thrives in our valleys.

380.name: Upgrade
380.summary: Upgrade what you already have — irrigation, plantings, hardscape, masonry, walls, or a waterfall — worked into your existing yard by a crew that knows the local ground.

370.name: Design (Landscape)
370.summary: Landscape design shaped by decades of knowing our soil, water, and climate — with renderings so you see the plan first and plants chosen to live past their first year.

384.name: Patios
384.summary: Durable patios in stamped concrete or pavers that extend your living space outdoors and hold up to our freeze-thaw winters — planned around how you'll actually use the space.

383.name: Retaining Walls
383.summary: Retaining walls that hold back our slopes and terraced valley lots — built to drain properly and last through freeze-thaw, with structure and looks in one.

385.name: Rock Work
385.summary: Boulders, dry creek beds, and decorative rock that fit our high-desert setting — low-water, low-maintenance ways to add structure that hold up through drought.

378.name: Water Features
378.summary: Ponds, waterfalls, and streams built to run efficiently on our water — a focal point that fits the landscape without becoming a chore or a water hog.

394.name: Tree & Shrub Planting
394.summary: The right tree in the right spot — years of watching what handles our alkaline soil and dry conditions means we plant things that live, not things that struggle.

386.name: Sodding
386.summary: Instant, established lawn from quality sod — the fastest way to green ground, laid on properly prepped soil so it roots and holds in our climate.

381.name: Hydro Seeding
381.summary: Hydroseeding — a spray of seed and mulch that fills in a thick lawn in about a week at half the cost of sod, and great for slopes and erosion control on our terrain.

382.name: Xeriscaping
382.summary: Low-water landscaping designed for the high desert — drought-tough plantings and smart layout that stay beautiful on a fraction of a traditional lawn's water.

393.name: Check Up
393.summary: A scheduled walk-through of every zone — catching broken heads, dry spots, and leaks before our high water rates turn a small problem into a big bill.

371.name: Design (Sprinkler)
371.summary: Sprinkler design built on decades of local knowledge — which areas have irrigation water, which have pressure, which run dirty — so your system waters right from day one.

392.name: Installation
392.summary: Dependable sprinkler installation with commercial-grade parts for our high-desert lawns, where soil drains fast and hot spots are common — built right so we're not digging it up later.

368.name: Repair
368.summary: A full repair crew with 50+ years combined experience on every system out here — domestic, irrigation, well, dual, and greywater — and just about every brand and pipe made.

375.name: Spring Start Up
375.summary: We bring your system up in spring the right way — checking every zone for winter freeze damage before it costs you, and only once the hard freezes are safely past.

1649.name: Backflow Testing and Certification
1649.summary: Required annual backflow testing by licensed technicians — we test, certify, and file the paperwork with your water authority to keep your system compliant and the water supply safe.

1647.name: Landscape Lighting
1647.summary: Low-voltage landscape lighting that highlights your yard's best features and lights paths safely — balanced, not overlit, and built to hold up to Colorado seasons.

1648.name: Exterior Lighting
1648.summary: Exterior lighting for beauty, safety, and security after dark — fixtures placed and wired to last, whether it's a new system, an upgrade, or fixing what you have.

396.name: Holiday Decorations
396.summary: Professionally hung Christmas lights and holiday décor — we design, install, take down, and store it, so you enjoy the display without the ladder.

391.name: Estimate
391.summary: Free, no-pressure estimates — we'll walk your property, talk through what you want, and put real numbers in front of you before anything's committed.

1277.name: Weed Control (Weed Spraying)
1277.summary: Licensed weed spraying for lawns, landscape beds, and problem areas — the hands-on treatment our crews carry out, timed to our growing season by certified applicators.
